exampleEn: I didn't want to give in, but I had no choice.
exampleKo: 나는 양보하고 싶지 않았지만, 선택의 여지가 없었다.
gameExamples: She refused to give in, even when the pressure became overwhelming.
After hours of negotiation, they decided to give in to the demands of the other party.
He was determined not to give in to fear during the difficult times.
